# Polska: Poland as a strategy map built from real data

> Polska draws real Poland as a hex strategy map: terrain, towns, yields, lenses and resources, every figure from a public source (GUS, Eurostat, PKW, GIOŚ, UNESCO and others). The atlas has a text page with dated, sourced figures for Poland, each of the 16 voivodeships and each of the 203 towns of 20,000 or more people.

Poland had 37,242,958 residents on 30 June 2026. Pages are in English; place names keep their Polish spelling.

## App

- [Polska, the map](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/): interactive hex map with lenses, town views and advisors (needs JavaScript)

## Atlas

- [Poland in numbers](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/): national figures, the 16 voivodeships and links to every page
- [Full text](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/llms-full.txt): every atlas page as compact markdown in one file
- [Dolnośląskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/dolnoslaskie/index.md): Dolnośląskie has the 2nd highest average gross wage of the 16 voivodeships: 9,208 zł a month in May 2026.
- [Kujawsko-Pomorskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/kujawsko-pomorskie/index.md): Kujawsko-Pomorskie has the least tree cover of the 16 voivodeships: 31% of its land.
- [Lubelskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/lubelskie/index.md): Lubelskie has the lowest average gross wage of the 16 voivodeships: 7,982 zł a month in May 2026.
- [Lubuskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/lubuskie/index.md): Lubuskie has the most tree cover of the 16 voivodeships: 60% of its land.
- [Łódzkie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/lodzkie/index.md): Women in Łódzkie have the shortest life expectancy of the 16 voivodeships: 81.4 years at birth in 2025.
- [Małopolskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/malopolskie/index.md): Małopolskie has the 2nd most tourist nights per resident of the 16 voivodeships: 5.0 in 2025.
- [Mazowieckie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/mazowieckie/index.md): Mazowieckie is the most populous voivodeship, with 5,502,043 residents on 30 June 2026.
- [Opolskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/opolskie/index.md): Opolskie is the least populous voivodeship, with 919,766 residents on 30 June 2026.
- [Podkarpackie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/podkarpackie/index.md): Podkarpackie has the lowest personal income tax revenue per resident of the 16 voivodeships: 3,368 zł planned for 2026.
- [Podlaskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/podlaskie/index.md): Women in Podlaskie have the 2nd longest life expectancy of the 16 voivodeships: 83.7 years at birth in 2025.
- [Pomorskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/pomorskie/index.md): Pomorskie grew by 2.2% between 2015 and 2025, the 2nd fastest growth of the 16 voivodeships.
- [Śląskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/slaskie/index.md): Śląskie is the 2nd most populous voivodeship, with 4,246,702 residents on 30 June 2026.
- [Świętokrzyskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/swietokrzyskie/index.md): Świętokrzyskie lost 8.7% of its residents between 2015 and 2025, the steepest fall of the 16 voivodeships.
- [Warmińsko-Mazurskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/warminsko-mazurskie/index.md): Warmińsko-Mazurskie has the highest registered unemployment of the 16 voivodeships: 9.3% in October 2026.
- [Wielkopolskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/wielkopolskie/index.md): Wielkopolskie has the lowest registered unemployment of the 16 voivodeships: 3.8% in October 2026.
- [Zachodniopomorskie](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/zachodniopomorskie/index.md): Zachodniopomorskie has the most tourist nights per resident of the 16 voivodeships: 10.7 in 2025.

## Data

- [Data catalogue](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/index.json): every data file with its fields, rows, vintage and publishers
- [data/world.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/world.json): The hex grid of Poland: owner voivodeship and gmina per hex, elevation, water, relief, land cover, rivers, lakes.
- [data/cities.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/cities.json): Every town with town rights (1 January 2026), with population, growth, wage, unemployment, GDP share, yields and ranks.
- [data/metros.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/metros.json): Metro areas: Eurostat functional urban areas of Poland, with their member gminas and economic figures.
- [data/states.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/states.json): The 16 voivodeships: population, growth, GDP, wage, unemployment, jobs by PKD section, capitals, land cover.
- [data/nation.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/nation.json): National figures of Poland and the yield definitions.
- [data/counties.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/counties.json): Every gmina (TERYT7) with about 30 metrics: density, age, migration, PIT, wage, unemployment, education, faith, vote, air, flood, land cover.
- [data/powiaty.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/powiaty.json): Every powiat (TERYT4) with the same metrics, summed or weighted from its gminas.
- [data/lenses.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/lenses.json): The map lenses: one value per hex for each metric, with legend domains and notes.
- [data/resources.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/resources.json): Power plants, mines, oil and gas sites, offshore wind and renewables by powiat.
- [data/infrastructure.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/infrastructure.json): Motorways, expressways and main railway lines on hex links, plus seaports and airports.
- [data/military.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/military.json): Garrisons, bases, allied sites and training areas, with strength and budget.
- [data/wonders.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/wonders.json): Heritage and landmark sites chosen by published rules: UNESCO properties, national parks, research universities, record landmarks.
- [data/trade.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/trade.json): Road and rail freight routes between regions.
- [data/citizens.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/citizens.json): Citizen mix of each town of 20,000+: workers by sector, age, sex, education, origin.
- [data/districts.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/districts.json): Districts and city types of each town of 20,000+, from location quotients of jobs by PKD section.
- [data/disasters.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/disasters.json): The gminas declared a natural disaster area after the September 2024 flood.
- [data/sources.json](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/sources.json): The bibliography: every source with publisher, licence, vintage and the exact files used.

## Sources

- [Statistics Poland (GUS), regional statistical offices](https://stat.gov.pl/spisy-powszechne/nsp-2021/nsp-2021-wyniki-ostateczne/): NSP 2021 education by powiat
- [ORLEN, Gaz-System (via the cited pages); positions from Wikidata and OpenStreetMap](https://www.orlen.pl/en): Oil and gas in Poland: Baltic Pipe, main fields, refineries (curated)
- [OpenStreetMap contributors; operators (PGE, Enea, Tauron, Orlen, Energa, Polenergia, PEJ), PSE](https://www.openstreetmap.org/): Power plants of Poland (100 MW or more; solar 50 MW or more), offshore wind and nuclear
- [Urząd Regulacji Energetyki (Energy Regulatory Office); powiat codes from GUS BDL](https://www.ure.gov.pl/pl/oze/potencjal-krajowy-oze/8108,Instalacje-odnawialnych-zrodel-energii-stan-na-30-wrzesnia-2026-r.html): Installed renewable capacity by powiat (URE Mapa OZE)
- [Statistics Poland (GUS) and dane.gov.pl](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/ludnosc/migracje-zagraniczne-ludnosci/): Temporary protection and PESEL UKR status
- [Statistics Poland (GUS), Eurostat and European Central Bank](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/national-accounts/data/database): Polish national and regional accounts
- [NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (served by the NOAA PIFSC ERDDAP)](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/etopo-global-relief-model): ETOPO 2022 global relief model (15 arc-second)
- [Copernicus Global Land Service (VITO), distributed on Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/3939050): Copernicus Global Land Cover 100 m, forest type layer (epoch 2019)
- [Eurostat](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/local-administrative-units): Functional urban areas: LAU 2025 to city and FUA correspondence
- [WWF HydroSHEDS (Lehner and Grill 2013)](https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrorivers): HydroRIVERS v1.0, Europe
- [Eurostat GISCO](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco/geodata/statistical-units/local-administrative-units): Local Administrative Units (LAU) 2024, 1:1 million
- [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/): Natural Earth 1:10m (countries, lakes, rivers, Europe supplements)
- [Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS); OpenStreetMap contributors](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/ludnosc/ludnosc/powierzchnia-i-ludnosc-w-przekroju-terytorialnym-w-2026-r-,7,23.html): Towns of Poland: population on 30 June 2026 and position
- [Statistics Poland (GUS), Local Data Bank (BDL) API](https://bdl.stat.gov.pl/bdl/start): Territorial units of Poland in 2026 (TERYT codes)
- [European Space Agency (ESA WorldCover consortium)](https://esa-worldcover.org/): ESA WorldCover 2021 (v200), 10 m land cover
- [Ministry of Industry (report on hard coal mining 2025), State Mining Authority (WUG), KGHM, Sejm; positions from Wikidata and OpenStreetMap](https://www.gov.pl/web/wug/kwk): Mines of Poland: coal, lignite, copper and silver, salt, sulphur (curated)
- [Główny Inspektorat Ochrony Środowiska (GIOŚ)](https://powietrze.gios.gov.pl/pjp/archives): Air quality: annual means of PM2.5, PM10 and benzo(a)pyrene by station
- [Rada Ministrów (Dziennik Ustaw, via the Sejm ELI API); PKW and GUS for unit codes](https://api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2024/1395): Area of the 2024 flood state of natural disaster
- [Państwowa Komisja Wyborcza (PKW)](https://wybory.gov.pl/prezydent2025/pl/dane_w_arkuszach): Election results by gmina (presidential 2025, Sejm 2023)
- [Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS); Instytut Statystyki Kościoła Katolickiego (ISKK); OpenStreetMap; Wikidata](https://stat.gov.pl/spisy-powszechne/nsp-2021/nsp-2021-wyniki-ostateczne/): Religious affiliation (NSP 2021), Mass attendance by diocese (ISKK) and dioceses
- [Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS), Bank Danych Lokalnych](https://bdl.stat.gov.pl/bdl/start): Doctors and hospital beds by powiat
- [UNESCO World Heritage Centre (data.unesco.org); Narodowy Instytut Dziedzictwa (dane.gov.pl)](https://data.unesco.org/explore/dataset/whc001/): UNESCO World Heritage in Poland and Pomniki Historii
- [Ministerstwo Obrony Narodowej (MON), NATO, US Army; cited Wikipedia unit pages](https://www.gov.pl/web/obrona-narodowa): Military garrisons, bases, allied sites, strength and budget
- [Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS); Wikidata](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/srodowisko-energia/srodowisko/ochrona-srodowiska-2025,1,26.html): National parks: area and visitors
- [Główny Urząd Statystyczny (GUS); Ministry of Science (RAD-on / POL-on); Wikidata](https://radon.nauka.gov.pl/dane): Universities: students, research categories, main campus
- [Statistics Poland (GUS)](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/rynek-pracy/): GUS labour publication tables
- [Ministry of Finance and Statistics Poland (GUS)](https://www.gov.pl/web/finanse/kwoty-dochodow-jednostek-samorzadu-terytorialnego-na-rok-2026-potrzeby-finansowe-podlegajace-sfinansowaniu-oraz-szczegolowe-dane-wykorzystane-do-ich-obliczenia): Polish local income, housing, and tourism statistics
- [Eurostat; OpenStreetMap contributors; Wikidata; Government of Poland](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/transport/database): Airports of Poland: traffic, positions and planned Port Polska
- [Eurostat (data from Statistics Poland, GUS)](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/transport/database): Road freight by NUTS 3 region and rail freight between regions (Eurostat)
- [OpenStreetMap contributors (via the Overpass API)](https://www.openstreetmap.org/): Motorways, expressways and main railway lines of Poland (OpenStreetMap)
- [Statistics Poland (GUS); Eurostat; port authorities and Gaz-System (curated items)](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/transport-i-lacznosc/transport/gospodarka-morska-w-polsce-w-2025-r-,7,23.html): Seaports of Poland: cargo tonnage and containers, LNG terminals

## How to cite

- [Cite this site](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/atlas/): "Polska: Poland as a strategy map built from real data", Jarek Tkaczyk, https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/, with the page URL and the date you read it
- [Cite the figures](https://softonsofa.com/pol-civ/data/sources.json): name the original publisher and year given next to each figure; the atlas pages list them under Sources
- [Source code](https://github.com/jarektkaczyk/pol-civ): MIT licence; the data stay under their publishers' terms
